description:
OutboxEntry (kith-store/src/outbox.rs:20) has kind: String. The possible values are 'message' and 'receipt' — a closed set. String comparisons appear on lines 243 (entry.kind == "receipt"), 258, and in the SQL pk (kind = ?5).

Suggestion:
  #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
  pub enum OutboxKind { Message, Receipt }
  impl OutboxKind { fn as_str(&self) -> &'static str { ... } }

This makes the arms in complete_delivery() and mark_failed() exhaustive matches, eliminates branch-missing bugs if a third kind is added, and removes the string literal scattered across the file. The SQL parameter binding uses the &'static str from as_str(), so no allocation change.

The comment at line 23 ('"message" or "receipt"') would become unnecessary — the type expresses it.
title: OutboxEntry.kind uses String instead of enum
